incident_id.description: Identifier of the analyzed incident bundle.

root_cause_guess.description: Single-call best guess explanation of the root cause.

confidence.description: Subjective confidence score reported by LLM (0.0 - 1.0).

evidence.description: List of evidence excerpts referenced by the baseline model.

source.description: Source category (e.g., logs, metrics, code, git_diff).

reference.description: Specific line number, timestamp, metric name, or file path.

excerpt.description: Exact text or value cited as evidence.
